luxury.en: How is the phone in a poor country more than just a consumer luxury?
luxury.zh: 在一个贫穷国家里，手机为什么不只是一件消费性的奢侈品？

luxury.en: With their bunkers, tech billionaires would be able to survive without compromising their luxury lifestyle.
luxury.zh: 有了地堡，科技亿万富翁就能在不牺牲豪华生活方式的情况下生存下来。

luxury.en: This tree produced a red dye that was used in Europe for creating luxury textiles.
luxury.zh: 这种树产一种红色染料，在欧洲被用来制作奢侈纺织品。

luxury.en: Bread, a staple of the Egyptian diet, became a luxury for some families.
luxury.zh: 面包，这个埃及人日常饮食的主食，对某些家庭来说已经成了一种奢侈品。

luxury.en: And what had once been a luxury of the Victorian upper classes became a global norm.
luxury.zh: 曾经属于维多利亚时代上流社会的奢侈品，变成了全球的常态。

lung.en: An ailment is another word for an illness or minor health problem, so a respiratory ailment is an illness of the lungs.
lung.zh: Ailment是疾病或轻微健康问题的另一个词，所以呼吸道疾病就是肺部疾病。

lung.en: And then one day they're like, oh, shit, I've got lung cancer. or my dad has lung cancer and they drop it immediately.
lung.zh: 然后有一天他们会想：“哦，该死，我得了肺癌”，或者“我爸爸得了肺癌”，然后他们立刻就戒了。

lung.en: And then one day they're like, oh, shit, I've got lung cancer. or my dad has lung cancer and they drop it immediately.
lung.zh: 然后有一天他们会想：“哦，该死，我得了肺癌”，或者“我爸爸得了肺癌”，然后他们立刻就戒了。

luxurious.en: Instead, they walked into what was effectively the world’s most luxurious detention centre.
luxurious.zh: 相反，他们走进了一个实际上堪称世界上最豪华的拘留中心的地方。

luxurious.en: You want to have a bigger house, a nicer car, a more luxurious life than your parents.
luxurious.zh: 你希望拥有比父母更大的房子、更好的车子以及更奢华的生活。

luxurious.en: This was not luxurious food. Hunger and starvation were actually serious risks for people across Britain, across Europe at the time.
luxurious.zh: 这并不是奢侈的食物。在当时的英国和整个欧洲，饥饿和挨饿实际上是人们面临的严重风险。

luxurious.en: And what about the title given to the greatest perfumers—the masters of scent, the artists who create the most luxurious fragrances in the world?
luxurious.zh: 那么，授予那些最伟大的调香师——气味大师、创造世界上最奢华香水的艺术家们的头衔是什么呢？

luxurious.en: And this was only the beginning. The next step in securing his absolute dominance was even more shocking: a royal purge that turned one of the capital's most luxurious hotels into a gilded prison.
luxurious.zh: 这仅仅是个开始。为了确保其绝对统治，下一步采取的举措更加令人震惊：一场将首都最豪华的酒店变成镀金监狱的王室清洗。

lunar.en: A lunar cycle – the time it takes for the moon to go from one full moon to the next – is about 29.5 days.
lunar.zh: 一个农历月——月亮从一个满月到下一个满月所需的时间——大约是 29.5 天。

lunar.en: Twelve of these lunar months make up roughly 354 days, so 11 days less than a solar year, but it was near enough.
lunar.zh: 这十二个农历月构成大约 354 天，比太阳年少 11 天，但也差不多了。
